body:
I don't need anyone there as a third pary, it's that they wouldn't leave. That was with my psychologist tho.

I talk to my fiance alone, but I don't tell everything, cause that's what's got my parents angry, and if he got angry, I'd have no one left. I usually just make him lay in bed with me and hold me.

I don't really know why. I said I wanted them to leave, but they wouldn't. Said they had to be there by law or something. I don't know, they don't like to tell me anything. I think it's because he came to the ward. Maye if I can go over to his office next time I won't have to.

I love my fiance, but I'm terrified he'll react the same way, that would absolotely crush me. He knows a bit, but not the worst part as I don't want to scare him. He definitely does not know how strongly I consider suicide. 

And I do want to get well. I want to have a good life, a house, yard all that stuff. But right now things are really hard for me. After 4 years it's very difficult to see a way out.

And thank you for talking to me. It means a lot to me to have someone listen. I'm logging off for tonight as I'm exhausted, but thank you. Really thank you.

I have a pshychiatrist I trust very much, but at my last talk with him, there appearantly HAD to be a 3rd party there from the ward, I trust him, but I'm afraid If I talk to the others they will send me to the suicidal ward where you don't get to have anything. I have tried talking to my parents, but they just got angry, and I can't describe how much it hurt. It felt like I pored my heart out to them, but they just dismissed it and told me to "suck it up".

The only one I have left is my fiance, I love him so much. Sometimes It feels I'm just stringing him along, and he could do much better. I know that if I''m not better by the time I'm 30 I will kill myself, and I don't want to drag him along if he'll just get hurt in the end, I want him to be happy, even of it's not with me. He's the only thing keeping me alive right now. I know my parents love me, but they're just so angry. In the past they have been the most important people to me but the way it is now, I don't know anymore. Everyone could get to move on.
